Top Pals for each of the 12 base work skills, ranked by their work suitability level (from the Palworld 1.0 dataset — all 262 Pals included).

Tip: these are the ceiling for each job. Lower-level Pals can fill in while you're early-game — use the Work Suitability Finder to see every Pal that can do a job.
